Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

A monokernel plugin's forward may never read some of the attention metadata the backend builds every step. The DeepSeek-V4.1 plugin (sgl-amd-mono) scores every index source itself, so on each routed decode step the HIP radix backend builds the aiter low-ratio decode schedule and nothing reads it.

## Modifications

- `BuiltMonokernels` gets an optional `skips_metadata(name, forward_batch, key, source)`. A plugin without it gets every metadata built, as before.
- `monokernels.runtime.skips_metadata(model, ...)` returns True only on a step the plugin's forward actually runs (its graph key is served) and when the plugin opts out; `_install_forward` keeps `(built, served)` on the model.
- The HIP radix backend asks it per ratio before building the low-ratio decode schedule (`"low_ratio_decode_schedule"`). No new env knob; nothing changes without `--monokernel-backend`.
- Unit test: the skip applies only on routed steps.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K (1319 questions), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, TP4 MI355X, `--monokernel-backend amd`: 0.903 (previous mono integration: 0.899). Measured on #44353 + #44405 + this change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Decode TPOT (TP4, c1, median of 3), on #44353 + #44405 + this change vs the previous mono integration: 8k input 1.440 -> 1.413 ms, 128k input 1.490 -> 1.436 ms. The schedule build this skips is about 1-3% of c1 TPOT.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -834,6 +834,12 @@ def of(cls, forward_mode: ForwardMode) -> _GraphBucket:
         raise NotImplementedError(f"unsupported {forward_mode=}")
 
 
+def _monokernel_skips(model, name, forward_batch, key, source) -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.monokernels.runtime import skips_metadata
+
+    return skips_metadata(model, name, forward_batch, key, source)
+
+
 class DeepseekV4HipRadixBackend(
     AttentionBackend,
     C4IndexerBackendMixin,
@@ -876,6 +882,7 @@ def __init__(
         speculative_num_steps=0,
     ):
         super().__init__()
+        self.model_runner = model_runner
         self.device = torch.device(model_runner.device)
         self.max_context_len = model_runner.model_config.context_len
         head_dim = model_runner.model_config.head_dim
@@ -1689,10 +1696,18 @@ def init_forward_metadata_in_graph(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch) -> None:
                         for ratio, indexer_metadata in (
                             metadata.low_ratio_indexer_metadata_by_ratio().items()
                         )
-                        # Identity rows are not scored, so they need no schedule.
+                        # Identity rows are not scored, so they need no schedule;
+                        # nor does a ratio a monokernel forward scores itself.
                         if not low_ratio_decode_rows_are_identity(
                             self, forward_batch, ratio
                         )
+                        and not _monokernel_skips(
+                            self.model_runner.model,
+                            "low_ratio_decode_schedule",
+                            forward_batch,
+                            ratio,
+                            indexer_metadata,
+                        )
                     }
                 )
             )

@@ -339,6 +339,22 @@ def forward(*args, **kwargs):
         return built.forward(Plan(key=key), *args, **kwargs)
 
     model.forward = forward
+    model._monokernel_routes = (built, served)
+
+
+def skips_metadata(model, name: str, forward_batch, key, source) -> bool:
+    """True when ``model``'s monokernel forward runs this step and never reads the
+    per-step attention metadata ``name`` (``key``, built from ``source``), so the
+    attention backend need not build it. False without a backend, for a step the
+    standard path runs, and for a plugin without ``skips_metadata``."""
+    routes = getattr(model, "_monokernel_routes", None)
+    if routes is None:
+        return False
+    built, served = routes
+    skip = getattr(built, "skips_metadata", None)
+    if skip is None or shape_key(forward_batch) not in served:
+        return False
+    return bool(skip(name, forward_batch, key, source))
 
 
 def _format_steps(keys: Iterable[ShapeKey]) -> str:

@@ -132,6 +132,11 @@ def forward(self, plan: Plan, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
         shapes fixed by plan.key.
         """
 
+    # Optional: skips_metadata(name, forward_batch, key, source) -> bool, True when
+    # this forward never reads the per-step attention metadata ``name`` (``key``,
+    # built from ``source``) of a routed step, so the backend need not build it
+    # (``runtime.skips_metadata``). Without it every metadata is built.
+
 
 class MonoSpec(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
     """A model-specific plugin contract; build returns its BuiltMonokernels."""

@@ -453,6 +453,24 @@ def test_the_runtime_reads_the_published_config(self):
             ],
         )
 
+    def test_metadata_skips_only_on_routed_steps(self):
+        name = "low_ratio_decode_schedule"
+        served = frozenset(
+            {ShapeKey(forward_mode="decode", batch_size=2, tokens_per_request=1)}
+        )
+        skipper = SimpleNamespace(skips_metadata=lambda n, *_: n == name)
+        model = SimpleNamespace(_monokernel_routes=(skipper, served))
+        routed, other = batch("decode", 2, 2), batch("decode", 4, 4)
+        self.assertTrue(runtime.skips_metadata(model, name, routed, 1, None))
+        self.assertFalse(runtime.skips_metadata(model, "other", routed, 1, None))
+        self.assertFalse(runtime.skips_metadata(model, name, other, 1, None))
+        # no backend, or a plugin that builds every metadata
+        self.assertFalse(
+            runtime.skips_metadata(SimpleNamespace(), name, routed, 1, None)
+        )
+        plain = SimpleNamespace(_monokernel_routes=(SimpleNamespace(), served))
+        self.assertFalse(runtime.skips_metadata(plain, name, routed, 1, None))
+
     def test_deadlines_stay_below_the_watchdog(self):
         self.assertEqual(deadline_s(None), MAX_DEADLINE_S)
         self.assertEqual(deadline_s(3600), MAX_DEADLINE_S)
